Advice: Try a DRAM-sharded program config (MatmulMultiCoreReuseMultiCastDRAMShardedProgramConfig) to improve throughput further

If possible place input 0 in L1 (currently in DEV_0_DRAM_INTERLEAVED) • in0_block_w=2 and output subblock 2x2 look good 🤷 • HiFi2 may also work, it discards the lowest bit of the activations and has 2x the throughput of HiFi4
